anomalies.description: After being shot, a man lies motionless on the floor while the shooter continues to aim the gun at him; this constitutes attacking a helpless victim.
A man in a grey vest fires a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash is visible and his face shows exertion consistent with firing.
A man with a bloody face points a handgun directly at the camera; the gun is held in a firing-ready position across multiple frames, indicating an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
A second man (in suit and glasses) grips a cane aggressively and prepares to strike; close-ups show his hand tightening on the cane handle, consistent with initiating a physical assault.
The first man (gunman) is shown slumped and unconscious or incapacitated after being struck; his head is thrown back and eyes closed, indicating he has been rendered helpless by the prior attack.
The man in the suit uses an umbrella as a weapon to strike the gunman mid-air; the umbrella is open and positioned to intercept/impact the falling opponent, confirming active combat.
